artifact: Isolated production build served locally; no development-only script behavior.
validationMethod: Full intro and interaction acceptance first, then focused reruns after header-only repairs. Unchanged intro/no-JS/failsafe evidence is retained rather than rerunning the viewport matrix. Accepted scenarios are grouped by their latest passing stage; detailed frame and geometry observations stay in the local evidence files.

failuresAtThatStage.name: webkit burger opens an anchored nonmodal dropdown with native keyboard flow
failuresAtThatStage.message:
Expected values to be strictly equal:

'false' !== 'true'

coveredBehavior: Viewport-covering paper intro, centered AA SVG, no initial content flash, finite smooth reveal and pointer/focus release at 320, 390, 768 and 1440 CSS px in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.
Reload replays the intro; actual history Back exposes useful content without replay. BFCache restoration itself is not claimed.
Initial and runtime reduced motion bypass/cancel movement; keyboard input during intro reveals the site immediately.
No-JavaScript content/navigation/image links/public contact and blocked-network-module inline safety exit stay usable.

Icon-only 48px disclosure, anchored nonmodal navigation with no top-layer dialog/backdrop/inert content/focus trap; Escape, same-trigger toggle, outside click, focus leaving, desktop resize, rapid toggles, landscape and 200% text.
Escape focus return followed by click reopen stays expanded; actual Contact navigation works with normal and reduced motion in all three engines.
Filters retain count/URL across reload, original PDF remains retrievable, native gallery image zoom remains functional, and its immediate Escape is preserved while a dropdown exit runs.
Two WCAG 2 A/AA, 2.1 AA and 2.2 AA axe scans (Home and expanded mobile dropdown) report zero violations; no uncaught application errors in the final engine runs.

resolvedRegressions.issue: Reduced-motion pointer selection of a dropdown anchor lost navigation in Chromium/Firefox because focusout inspected transient BODY focus before destination focus.
resolvedRegressions.resolution: Close on actual document focusin outside the header and window blur; outside pointer handling remains direct. Anchor selection cleanup is deferred until native activation.

resolvedRegressions.issue: WebKit Escape focus return followed by click reopening was canceled by a stale null-destination focusout timer.
resolvedRegressions.resolution: Removed deferred focus inspection; confirmed stable reopen plus actual Contact activation in normal and reduced motion.

resolvedRegressions.issue: An exiting dropdown consumed immediate Escape intended for a newly opened native image viewer.
resolvedRegressions.resolution: Only an open dropdown handles Escape. Native viewer Escape verified before the 150ms dropdown exit finished in all three engines.

reviewArtifacts.note: Actual Playwright screen recording and unmodified rendered screenshots; no slowed animation clock or composed mockup.

testGuard.notes: Assertions inspect real visible geometry, hit testing, keyboard/pointer results, native destinations and reduced-motion behavior. Media emulation and failed HTTP script requests are browser/system boundaries; no internal application mocks.

limitations: Automated desktop Chromium, Firefox and WebKit engines with mobile-sized viewports; no physical mobile hardware or screen reader.
Finite intro, dropdown and focused existing interaction regressions; not a repeat of the earlier full-site route matrix.
First-paint observations are requestAnimationFrame samples; a real recording and screenshots accompany the behavior checks.
